results.reader_title: EU recovery-fund wind-down threatens research employment continuity
results.reader_what: As EU Recovery and Resilience Facility payments end in 2026, research teams in Italy and Greece face loss of temporary
results.reader_why: Documents a concrete 2026 withdrawal of time-limited EU research support and differing national research-workforce retention mechanisms.
results.reader_more: Science reporting indicates €55.6bn of the €577bn RRF was earmarked for research and innovation. A €62.5m Greek programme supported 279 projects and 1,826 temporary staff; Italy’s CNR faced contract-expiry and knowledge-loss issues. Portugal’s FCT-Tenure has a first round supporting 1,104 permanent positions with staged national cost sharing. The 2026 expiry is real, but nationwide workforce impact is not quantified.
